mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_items ( order_id, product_id, quantity, product_price ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{productPrice} )
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, product_id, quantity, product_price FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT p.product_name AS "productName", p.image_url AS "imageUrl", oi.quantity AS "quantity", oi.product_price AS "productPrice", oi.quantity * oi.product_price AS "itemSubtotal" FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY p.id
